stemMd: A neutral science exhibit reads, "The instrument detects small changes in air pressure." Which continuation maintains that explanatory style?

options.label: A
options.textMd: This awesome gadget totally knows what the air is doing.

options.label: B
options.textMd: You would be silly not to love this machine.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Wow, pressure really is the boss around here!

options.label: D
options.textMd: A sensor converts each pressure change into an electrical signal.

explanationMd: The exhibit explains a mechanism without personal judgment or hype. Describing the sensor and electrical signal keeps the same objective explanatory tone.

distractorRationale.a: Promotional slang departs from the neutral explanation.
distractorRationale.b: An evaluative remark does not match the objective tone.
distractorRationale.c: The exclamation and metaphor disrupt the technical explanation.
